# gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_interfaces (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_interfaces" "example_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster_interfaces" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 7
  cluster_id = "1aaaab48-10d0-46d9-80cc-85209284ceb4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster unique identifier

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `floating_ips` (Attributes List) Bodies of floatingips that are NAT-ing ips of this port (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--floating_ips))
- `ip_assignments` (Attributes List) IP addresses assigned to this port (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--ip_assignments))
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the virtual port
- `network` (Attributes) Body of the network this port is attached to (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--network))
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network the port is attached to
- `port_id` (String) ID of virtual ethernet port object
- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean) Port security status

<a id="nestedatt--items--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Datetime when the floating IP was created
- `fixed_ip_address` (String) IP address of the port the floating IP is attached to
- `floating_ip_address` (String) IP Address of the floating IP
- `id` (String) Floating IP ID
- `port_id` (String) Port ID the floating IP is attached to. The `fixed_ip_address` is the IP address of the port.
- `router_id` (String) Router ID
- `status` (String) Floating IP status
Available values: "ACTIVE", "DOWN", "ERROR".
- `tags` (Attributes List) List of key-value tags associated with the resource. A tag is a key-value pair that can be associated with a resource, enabling efficient filtering and grouping for better organization and management. Some tags are read-only and cannot be modified by the user. Tags are also integrated with cost reports, allowing cost data to be filtered based on tag keys or values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--floating_ips--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Datetime when the floating IP was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--items--floating_ips--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.floating_ips.tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Tag key. Maximum 255 characters. Cannot contain spaces, tabs, newlines, empty string or '=' character.
- `read_only` (Boolean) If true, the tag is read-only and cannot be modified by the user
- `value` (String) Tag value. Maximum 255 characters. Cannot contain spaces, tabs, newlines, empty string or '=' character.

### Nested Schema for `items.ip_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `ip_address` (String) The IP address assigned to the port from the specified subnet
